basis: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4, p. 42; Minn-Dak Board Briefing V3, pp. 2-6
target_customer: Industrial processors; Minn-Dak is an uncommitted prospective design partner

problem.statement: For one approved asset family, maintenance planners may have to manually combine work-order history, repeat-failure context, downtime evidence, and repair cost to prepare reviewable maintenance priorities.
problem.no_build_option: Use or configure current CMMS/ERP/Power BI functionality if it already meets the need.

proposed_workflow: Read-only, synthetic work-order review: identify repeat events and present source-traceable candidate cases for a human to inspect; no autonomous ranking is authorized.
cohort: One prospect-approved asset family or plant area; not yet selected

primary_metric.name: Median analyst review minutes per completed maintenance case
primary_metric.evaluation_method: Matched manual-only versus assisted review on pre-registered synthetic cases; balanced order and blinded seeded labels

economics.note: Review-time reductions release capacity; cash savings require validated expenditure changes.
